title: BRIDGING EXPLAINABILITY AND EMBEDDINGS: BEE AWARE OF SPURIOUSNESS
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical framework (BEE) for detecting spurious correlations (shortcuts) in model embeddings. While it tests this framework on the CivilComments dataset, which includes religious and social categories, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or ethical frameworks themselves as a core research component.
